prompt:
Create a new 16:9 storyboard keyframe for a music video. Image 1 is the style reference: match its 1990s hand-painted cel anime look, ink line quality, film grain and VHS softness exactly. Image 2 is FAST's model sheet: draw FAST exactly on-model (same face, hair, skin tone, glasses, outfit and props). Image 3 is SLOW's model sheet: draw SLOW exactly on-model (same face, hair, skin tone, glasses, outfit and props). Sunrise: warm golden light unifies the whole frame in full color, hopeful and bright.
Scene: High crane view looking down on the crowd chanting under the overpass, arms raised, skateboards held up.
Camera: Overhead crane.
Characters: FAST and SLOW only, no one else unless the scene mentions extras. Their mouths are closed or relaxed (nobody is mid-word).
No readable text, letters, captions, subtitles or speech bubbles anywhere.
No borders, no panel frames, not a comic page.
